sources.entry: Waldium - AI-powered blogs to help ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity cite your product.

summary.name: Waldium
summary.one_liner: Waldium is a product from Structured Labs that builds AI-powered blogs intended to help AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity cite a business's product.
use_cases: get a product cited by ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity
publish ai-generated blog content about a business
make company knowledge machine-readable for ai search
improve visibility of a product in ai answers
summary.what_it_does: ["Waldium is described as an AI-powered blog product made by Structured Labs, aimed at helping ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity cite a business's product.", "Structured Labs describes its broader goal as turning every business's knowledge into structured, high-fidelity data for search, recommendation, and intelligent applications.", "The page also names Preswald as another product from the same company.", "The page text itself gives few concrete feature details about how Waldium's blogs are built or published."]
notable: Made by Structured Labs, backed by Y Combinator and General Catalyst
Sibling product Preswald from the same company
caveats: Page text gives no pricing or plan details
Page text gives little concrete information on how the product works
Page is a redirect to structuredlabs.com; the listing description is the main source for the product's purpose
